mapper.select: SELECT u2.ID, u2.FILE_NAME,u1.LE as LEVEL,u2.PARENT_ID FROM( SELECT @ids AS p_ids, (SELECT @ids := GROUP_CONCAT(ID) FROM DEV_FOLD WHERE FIND_IN_SET(PARENT_ID, @ids)) AS c_ids, @l := @l+1 AS LE FROM DEV_FOLD, (SELECT @ids := ${id}, @l := 0 ) b WHERE @ids IS NOT NULL ) u1 JOIN DEV_FOLD u2 ON FIND_IN_SET(u2.ID, u1.p_ids) AND IS_DIR = 1
SELECT SUM(b.FILE_SIZE) FROM DEV_FOLD a LEFT JOIN PAN_FILE b ON a.FILE_ID = b.ID WHERE CREATE_USER = #{userId}
